name: tune-landscape-miniplayer
note: Operator bug 2026-10-05: on a landscape phone, with the mini-player bar up, the Tune tab's bottom string row sat UNDER the bar - untappable, and no scroll could bring it out. Cause: #s-tune/.tunerWrap were clamped to exactly height:100% of the view (#82's no-scroll contract), while the mini-player (#323) reserves its space as .view padding-bottom - which only protects content that participates in the view's scroll. At 812x375 the bar leaves ~119px for a column whose minimum is ~200px (6 guitar strings wrap to two rows), so the column overflowed its clamped box into the padding the bar covers, and the scroller never grew. Asserts: in landscape (812x375, 915x412) the user can scroll the bottom string row fully clear of the bar and every bottom-row button hit-tests to itself at its centre and corners; the tuner card is not crushed into a scroll sliver; portrait 375x812 still fits on one screen with the strings above the bar and no scroll. The video is seeded parked ('hid') so the state under test is the plain bar, not the PIP dock. RED on main: the view's scrollHeight == clientHeight, so the second string row stays under the bar.
